test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Get on like a house on fire

options.text: Get on extremely well with someone
Feel a lot of affection for one particular person, often without knowing why
Do something good for someone you have done something bad to in the past

solution:
The solution is **Get on extremely well with someone,**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom 'Get on like a house on fire' is Get on extremely well with someone.(किसी के साथ बहुत अच्छे से घुलना-मिलना)
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about ***idioms:***

 
 
• ​A group of words established by usage as having a meaning not deducible from those of the individual words.
 
• For example:- 
 
 
• **Get your act together - **Get organized and do things effectively.(संगठित हो जाओ और काम प्रभावी ढंग से करो)
 
• **Back against the wall - **Stuck in a difficult circumstance with no escape.(ऐसी कठिन परिस्थिति में फँस गया हूँ जहाँ से निकलने का कोई रास्ता नहीं है)
 
• **On cloud nine - **Being very happy.(बहुत खुश हो रहे हैं)
